messages:
miles: heads-up — ran int4 conversion for gemma-v2 on the longctx suite and hit a quality regression around token 512+
sara: repro? small sample?
miles: gist: before-int4 vs after-int4 diverge after ~512 tokens, summary quality drops, hallucinations increase
kai: did you keep the tokenizer binary identical? ZWJ/soft-hyphen handling can sneak in differences
miles: tokenizer binary same, we used the converter v0.9.3, but the vocab id mapping changed for ~30 tokens (byte offset shift) during conversion
sam: converter change + rotary params could combine badly — headwise proj order?
miles: possible. also saw weird KV-cache warmup pattern: probabilities oscillate on repeated prefixes
april: what about perf/cost tradeoff? any wins with int4?
miles: cost down ~2.7x, lat ~15% faster. But regressions on our summarization eval are painful
sara: can you paste a tiny example input and logits diff?
miles: ```
input: <long multi-paragraph prompt truncated>
pos 490-530: token ids around the drift: [1678, 44, 0, 872, 234]
logit_delta (after - before): [-0.12, -0.4, +0.01, -1.2, -0.9]
```
kai: that -1.2 looks like a scaling/misaligned rotary phase issue to me — try a rotary scale sweep (0.6->1.2)
sam: I had luck with per-channel dynamic scale instead of global absmax for proj quantization
miles: tried global absmax and per-tensor; per-channel reduced some spots but still bad on longctx
sara: maybe vocab shadowing — if 30 ids remapped, embeddings shift and with int4 rounding that could cascade for long contexts
april: can we isolate: run conversion with a strict vocab-remap-preserve flag and see?
miles: plan: rerun with remap-preserve + rotary scale 0.75 + per-channel quant. queueing now
deploy-bot: CI triggered: model-onboard/gemma-v2-int4-retry #125. Logs will appear in ~45m
sam: also add test cases for combining diacritics + soft hyphen + ZWJ — those consistently exposed issues previously
kai: and add a kv-cache warmup check (repeat prefix 3x) — if cache index or stride off-by-one, longctx will fail only after warmup
miles: opened ticket INFR-4312 with repro, logs, and short eval set
sara: tentative remediation: if rotary sweep finds >0.7 improves, we can have converter default to scale=0.75 for gemma-v2 int4 and document it
april: timeline? we need a canary run by EOD Friday to decide whether to ship int4 as default in hosted catalog
miles: i'll try to get the first sweep and a short quality table by Thursday EOD, otherwise fallback to float16 canary
kai: one more ask — capture raw token alignment (pre/post conversion) for each run so we can diff token-level probs automatically
miles: will include that in the CI artifacts
sara: thanks — this looks actionable. keep the thread updated, I'll help triage the eval regressions
miles: thanks everyone, will ping once the reruns finish :thumbsup:
